q: The three arms of government in a democratic state are the Executive, Legislature, and ____. (P5)
explain: The Judiciary interprets the laws made by the legislature and enforced by the executive.
hint: The branch of courts and judges.

q: The arm of government responsible for making national laws is the ____. (P5)
explain: The Legislature (Senate and House of Representatives) debates and passes bills into law.
hint: Parliament / National Assembly.

q: The arm of government responsible for implementing and enforcing laws is the ____. (P5)
explain: The Executive (President, Governors, Ministers) administers the laws.
hint: Led by the President or Governor.

q: The arm of government responsible for interpreting laws and settling legal disputes is the ____. (P5)
explain: Courts of law and judges interpret the constitution and punish lawbreakers.
hint: System of courts and judges.
